cues.text: Let's allocate students to hostel beds.
Open Hostel and Allocations. The students who hold a bed are listed.
Press Allocate Student. Choose the student, the hostel and a room that has a free bed.
Press Allocate, and the student appears in the list with the room.
To free a bed, press Vacate on the student and confirm.
Choose Vacated in the status filter to see students who left, with the date.
